description: This file defines a custom exception class, SubscriptionProtocolErrorException, used for representing errors related to subscription protocol issues within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from causes or JSON objects, and contains a nested Builder class for constructing exception instances.

classes.name: SubscriptionProtocolErrorException
classes.description: A specialized exception class representing subscription protocol errors, with builder support for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a fluent API for constructing SubscriptionProtocolErrorException instances.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a Throwable cause and DittoHeaders, encapsulating the cause message.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating exceptions.

methods.name: getEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Provides a fresh builder object, overriding inherited behavior.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a JSON object and headers, parsing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with updated DittoHeaders.
